mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth is not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which signals a restrictive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the described condition is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if the interaction term between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not significantly negative in predicting 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs MoM signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS MoM and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts investor sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the described condition is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or if the interaction term between HOUST and UNRATE is not significantly positive in predicting 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < -1% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 YoY and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
